# Test fixtures

Clean test characters made for the parser's tests (nothing personal in them). Each file is
described here as it was set up in the game, so the parser's output can be checked against it.
"?" = not noted when the character was made; the parser's output fills these in after a manual
check in the game.

## journey.plr

- Character "test_char_journey", Journey mode; file version 326 (Terraria 1.4.5)
- Inventory: Copper Pickaxe in hotbar slot 1; Torch × 37 in hotbar slot 10; Dirt Block × 50 in the
  last inventory slot, marked as favorite
- Coin slots: 3 Gold Coins, 12 Silver Coins; ammo slots: Wooden Arrow × 123
- Trash slot: Gel (not saved by the game – it is not in the file)
- Equipment (loadout 1): Wood Helmet, Wood Breastplate, Wood Greaves; accessories: slot 1 Fledgling
  Wings (Wild), slot 2 Hermes Boots (no prefix), slot 5 Treasure Magnet (Brisk)
- Vanity: slot 1 Ox33's Aviators, its dye slot Red Dye
- Loadout 2: Shadewood Helmet; loadout 3: Ebonwood Helmet
- Misc equipment: Grappling Hook (hook), Slimy Saddle (mount), Eyebone (pet), Minecart (minecart),
  Shadow Orb (light pet)
- Storages, first slot / last slot:
  - Piggy Bank: Wood / Stone Block
  - Safe: Dirt Block / Torch
  - Defender's Forge: Gel / Silver Bar
  - Void Vault: Gold Coin / Silver Coin
- Permanent upgrades: 2 Life Crystals, 1 Mana Crystal; no Demon Heart, no other permanent boosters
- Journey research: Copper Pickaxe and Dirt Block fully researched, Wood 30/100
